title: bug: JetBrains Accounts launch still resolves bare powershell or WSL node at the project cwd
description: Residual explicitly excluded from task-b071e3bf: TerminalAgentLauncher.buildAccountsCommand uses powerShellLine's bare powershell default on Windows and literal `node ` under WSL, even for protected projects. A project powershell.bat in a Command Prompt terminal, or project node on an in-project PATH entry, can run before the selected Accounts CLI. Pin and validate trusted interpreters without changing legacy lines; account for WSL node having no fixed system path.
definitionOfDone: Protected Accounts launch never resolves its interpreter through project cwd or unsafe PATH; refusal launches nothing.
Legacy Accounts lines remain byte-identical and tests cover native Windows and WSL refusal/selection.
